# Prometheus License Provenance & Compliance Evidence

Project: Prometheus
Component Family: Prometheus Server
Verified License Identifier: Apache-2.0 (Apache License, Version 2.0)
Verification Date: 2026-09-29
Compliance Disposition: ACCEPTABLE (Permissive open source; approved for Phase-1 Task-1K adoption)

## Verified Upstream Source

1. Prometheus Server
   - Distribution / Container Image: prom/prometheus
   - Official Upstream Repository: https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus
   - Official LICENSE Location: https://github.com/prometheus/prometheus/blob/main/LICENSE
   - License: Apache-2.0
   - Phase-1 Role: Standalone time-series metrics server scraping the OpenTelemetry Collector metrics endpoint (:8889) under the optional `observability` Compose profile

## Architectural Boundaries & Isolation
- Deployed exclusively as a decoupled container service communicating over standard HTTP network protocols.
- Never imported as a direct in-process runtime library in E-7 application code.
- Prometheus scrapes the OpenTelemetry Collector; the headless worker has no direct inbound HTTP metrics scrape port.
- Grafana visualization is NOT part of Phase 1 and remains deferred to Phase 7.

## Attribution & Usage Policy
- Operate unmodified official container images (`prom/prometheus`).
- Include standard Apache-2.0 copyright and NOTICE files in external container distribution manifests.
- Zero source code copying into the IR proprietary application core.
